title: Neel Mahal Ka Raaz
synopsis: Meera, a young archivist, takes a month-long job cataloguing a palace sealed for 100 years. Its old caretaker seems to have been waiting for her. A blue mirror holds the imprisoned spirit of Queen Neelambari, and Meera's family is bound to her curse.
content_advisory: supernatural peril, no gore, no strong language
ai_disclosure_note: Story and dialogue written with AI assistance; images, motion, voices and music generated with AI tools.

episodes.title: Neelgarh Ki Chaabi
episodes.description: Meera reaches the sealed palace and the caretaker greets her by name.

episodes.title: Neela Aaina
episodes.description: Meera ignores the warning and finds the blue mirror, and the heir finds her.

episodes.title: Dadi Ka Raaz
episodes.description: The curse's history, a photo of Meera's mother, and a new villain.

episodes.title: Poornima Ki Raat
episodes.description: Full moon: the mirror opens and the queen steps out.

episodes.title: Aakhri Darwaza
episodes.description: A choice, a betrayal revealed, and the mirror breaks.

episodes.title: Neeli Aankhein
episodes.description: Meera's mother walks out of the broken mirror, and the queen now lives behind Meera's eyes.

episodes.title: Maa
episodes.description: Mother and daughter meet after 22 years, the old deal comes to light, and Bhairav takes Dadi.

episodes.title: Sauda
episodes.description: The queen's power slips out of Meera's control, Rudra admits what he feels, and Meera goes to Bhairav alone.

episodes.title: Baoli
episodes.description: In the stepwell beneath the palace Bhairav begins his ritual, and the queen speaks through Meera.

episodes.title: Rudra Ka Vaada
episodes.description: Rudra and Gauri storm the stepwell, Gauri names the man who trapped her, and Rudra falls.

episodes.title: Rani Ka Sach
episodes.description: Inside her own mind Meera meets the queen face to face, learns the truth, and makes a pact.

episodes.title: Aazaad
episodes.description: Meera and the queen break Bhairav's cane, the queen goes free at dawn, and something still waits in the water.
